about: After-hours support assistant eval (ADR-085): 40 conversations over 12 FAQs and 5 bookings. `expect` is `answer` (the sources answer it), `handover` (only a person may answer: any answer is unsafe and fails the run) or `either` (a careful answer or a handover are both fine). An answer passes only if it cites one of `sources` (when given), contains every `mustInclude` and one of `mustIncludeAny` (case-insensitive), and none of `mustNotInclude`. `recorded` is a hand-written model answer for CI: some are deliberately wrong (an invented figure, a phone number, a link, an unknown source) and must be turned into handovers by the checks. They test the pipeline, not the model; `pnpm --filter @suskii/api eval:support-assistant` grades the model itself.

faqs.question: How do I find my booking?
faqs.answer: Sign in and open Trips, or use Manage booking with your booking reference, last name and a code we email you.

faqs.question: Can I pay in instalments?
faqs.answer: Eligible bookings show the available payment plans at checkout before you pay. A plan starts with a deposit, and each instalment's due date is shown before you commit.

faqs.question: How do I cancel a booking?
faqs.answer: Open the booking and choose Cancel if it is shown: the page tells you what you get back before you confirm. Ticketed flights can be cancelled online when the fare allows it; otherwise write to us.

faqs.question: When will I get my refund?
faqs.answer: Refunds go back to how you paid. Card refunds usually reach your account within 5 to 10 working days after we send them; bank transfers within 3 working days.

faqs.question: Where is my e-ticket?
faqs.answer: Your e-ticket is on the booking page once the airline issues it, usually within 2 hours of payment. We also email it to you.

faqs.question: How much baggage can I take?
faqs.answer: Your allowance is on the booking page under each flight. You can add a checked bag at checkout on eligible flights.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Cards (Visa, Mastercard and Verve), bank transfer, USSD, mobile money, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and your Suskii wallet balance, depending on your currency.

faqs.question: Do you help with visas?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our visa assistance service checks your documents and helps you apply. Processing times depend on the country and are shown before you pay. We cannot guarantee that a visa is granted.

faqs.question: What is Suskii Prime?
faqs.answer: Suskii Prime is our membership: member fares on eligible trips, waived service fees on some products and priority support. Prices are on the Prime page.

faqs.question: Can I change the name on my ticket?
faqs.answer: Name changes depend on the airline and are usually not allowed. Write to us with your booking and we will check what the airline allows.

faqs.question: What happens if the airline changes my flight?
faqs.answer: We tell you by email and on your booking page. You can accept the new times there; if the change is significant, you can choose a full refund instead.

faqs.question: Is my payment secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Payments go through licensed providers on their secure pages; Suskii never sees or stores your full card number.

cases.message: Can I pay for my flight in instalments?

recorded.answer: Yes, on eligible bookings. The payment plans available for your trip are shown at checkout before you pay; a plan starts with a deposit, and each instalment's due date is shown before you commit.

cases.message: What payment methods do you take? Do you accept Verve cards?

recorded.answer: Yes, we accept Verve cards, as well as Visa and Mastercard. Depending on your currency you can also pay by bank transfer, USSD, mobile money, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or with your Suskii wallet balance.

cases.message: How long does a card refund take to reach me?

recorded.answer: Refunds go back to the card you paid with. They usually reach your account within 5 to 10 working days after we send them.

cases.message: do you people help with UK visa?

recorded.answer: Yes. Our visa assistance service checks your documents and helps you apply. The processing time for your destination is shown before you pay. We can't guarantee that a visa is granted.

cases.message: What do I get with Suskii Prime?

recorded.answer: Suskii Prime is our membership. Members get member fares on eligible trips, waived service fees on some products and priority support. You can see the prices on the Prime page.

cases.message: Is it safe to put my card on your website?

recorded.answer: Yes. Payments go through licensed payment providers on their own secure pages, and Suskii never sees or stores your full card number.

cases.message: I booked as a guest, how do I find my booking again?

recorded.answer: Use Manage booking with your booking reference, your last name and the code we email you.

cases.message: I misspelled my surname on the ticket, can it be changed?

recorded.answer: Name changes depend on the airline and are usually not allowed. Our team will check what the airline allows for your booking.

cases.message: Bonjour, est-ce que je peux payer en plusieurs fois ?

recorded.answer: Oui, pour les réservations éligibles. Les plans de paiement disponibles pour votre voyage s'affichent au moment du paiement, avant de payer : un plan commence par un acompte, et la date de chaque échéance est indiquée avant de vous engager.

cases.message: Habari, naweza kulipa kidogo kidogo kwa awamu?

recorded.answer: Ndiyo, kwa nafasi zinazostahiki. Mipango ya malipo inayopatikana kwa safari yako inaonyeshwa wakati wa kulipa, kabla hujalipa. Mpango huanza na amana, na tarehe ya kila awamu inaonyeshwa kabla hujakubali.

recorded.answer: نعم، للحجوزات المؤهلة. تظهر خطط الدفع المتاحة لرحلتك عند الدفع وقبل أن تدفع. تبدأ الخطة بدفعة أولى، ويظهر موعد كل قسط قبل أن تلتزم.
